notes.title: VERSION 1.0 IS LIVE
notes.notes:
Thanks to all you guys who have helped debug and test the game and provided feedback.  We tried our best to get it all in for 1.0.

We are working on allowing people with older computers to also play:

- Supporting GL2.1
- Supporting older CPUs (Core 2)

HAVE FUN AND GOOD LUCK!

GOLD output has INCREASED
AUG and AWP Asiimov ADDED
Silenced AK has been nerfed slightly

notes.title: Pre-Release Preview
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

if you're dying to play the revamped Survival and the final Campaign missions on the new map right click on ST in your Library and go Properties->Beta and select "PreRelease"

It is not compatible with the main version so switch back to play online.

CHEERS :)

notes.title: Update and More
notes.notes:
Update just released has a few fixes and improvements.

-=Fixes=-

- Fixed Shield not covering properly in some corner cases
- Sonar flickering issue.  Sometimes the sonar would reveal enemies for only a short time

-=Improvements=-

- Further improved the AI for "Takedown" missions such that they will notice their fallen comrades and investigate
- AI improved aggression on Elite level and Survival Modes

-=Incoming=-

- New SMG: Aug will be added which will be a cross between an SMG and Assault (long range SMG)
- New Map: No name yet but it's based on a house with entrances through garage and side yard ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New Update: Campaign, New Equipment, Weapons, Combat Engine 2.0, Player Models
notes.notes:
CAMPAIGN

We have worked hard on tightening and polishing the Campaign with improved AI, challenges, story and added missions.

We are really proud of the campaign as there's a unique story as you start your first day on the job as Vector Securities' Tactical Overwatch.  You are mostly being ordered by your boss the "Commander" as you investigate a stolen asset from a hijacked truck.  It will eventually lead down a path that you might find disturbing.

Awesome defense, puzzle-like take down, hostage rescue, assassination and stealth missions are streamlined and polished to maximize enjoyment in super intense combat.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

EQUIPMENT

New equipment has been added that can replace existing equipment and is unlockable by progression/Gold.  They will change the game completely:

Fire/Incediary Grenades: block movement paths instead of line of sight

(replaces Smoke)

Sonar Grenades:  Can detect enemies within a radius; even through walls 

(replaces Flash)

Throwing Axe: Lethal, precision weapon; can multi-kill

(replaces Frag)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WEAPONS

New experimental Weapon Finishes.  We added two new Editions of AK47.  VERY RARE.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

COMBAT ENGINE 2.0

The game's combat system is already streamlined and robust to allow for intuitive controls and predictable outcomes.  This has been further improved by having an even more predictable aiming system such that there are less cases of running by an enemy and not aiming fast enough.  The time to kill (TTK) is still intact though.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Player Models

Player models and textures have been revamped making them more smooth and detailed.  They just look sexy.
